summary: Design NGO PMO services, governance and portfolio reporting through practical exercises. Explore the five-day training outline.
lede: Project management office (PMO) training helps NGO project managers, PMO leads and programme staff shape useful services, governance and portfolio oversight. It supports practical work to define PMO services and decision rights, build a portfolio inventory and prioritisation criteria, and improve project data and reporting for clearer portfolio reviews.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for intermediate-level professionals who shape PMO services or provide project information, governance and portfolio oversight in NGO settings.
prerequisites: Suitable for professionals with experience in project, programme or operations work. You should be familiar with basic project plans, status updates and delivery risks. No coding or programming is required.
